purpose: Binding minimum evidence floor for claims of whole-scope physical superiority, not a mandate to implement future SOROK science or delay lawful P0 C11 engineering.
material_exclusion_rule: An excluded cell must have an explicit bounded negative architectural argument and a distinct B challenge with evidence; C must independently adjudicate all exclusions before H1 receiving. A comparison with exclusions is provisional and cannot alone confer full-scope dominance.
new_discriminator_rule: B may raise a source/consumer-grounded, choice-reversing discriminator after H0. Independently qualify causal materiality, freeze addendum before its results, run the smallest possible lawful test or HOLD without selecting a winner; reject post-hoc convenience additions and result-driven removals.
uncertainty_rule: Overlapping or missing matched results with a plausible reversal cannot be extinguished by no-established-B-advantage or author-controlled decision_reverser=false. Explicit external B challenge and independent C disposition are required for any minimal-change tie-break.
relative_scope: All comparator outputs are structural arithmetic. They do not authenticate receipts or scientific/source/actor grants. Independent qualified C review and competent owner H1 remain mandatory.
